name: Parabolic_TrailingStop
summary: This EA is a trailing stop utility that uses the Parabolic SAR indicator to dynamically adjust stop loss levels on existing open positions. It does not open any new trades itself but instead manages trailing stops for positions already opened by the trader or another EA, moving the stop loss along with the Parabolic SAR to lock in profits as the trend progresses.
summary_zh: 该EA是一个基于抛物线SAR指标的移动止损工具，用于动态调整已有持仓的止损水平。它本身不开仓，而是跟随抛物线SAR指标移动止损位，在趋势延续时逐步锁定利润。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是利用抛物线SAR（Stop and Reverse）指标作为动态追踪止损的基准。当持仓方向为多头时，EA会读取当前Bar上的SAR值，若SAR值高于当前止损位则将止损上移至SAR值，实现利润锁定；空头持仓则反向操作，将止损下移至SAR值。入场条件方面，该EA本身不具备入场逻辑，完全依赖外部已有持仓。出场条件由SAR止损触发被动平仓，不包含主动止盈逻辑。仓位管理不涉及，因为EA不负责开仓。资金管理方面同样不涉及，止损距离完全由SAR参数决定，没有额外的风险百分比或固定点数止损设置。整体而言，这是一种纯趋势跟随型的止损管理工具，适合趋势行情但可能在震荡市中因SAR频繁翻转而导致止损被反复触发。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA uses the Parabolic SAR (Stop and Reverse) indicator as the dynamic reference point for trailing stop management. For long positions, the EA reads the current SAR value on each bar and raises the stop loss to the SAR value if it is higher than the current stop, thereby locking in unrealized profits as the trend advances; for short positions, it performs the inverse operation by lowering the stop loss to the SAR value. Entry conditions are not applicable since this EA does not open any positions itself and relies entirely on externally existing trades. Exit conditions are purely passive through the SAR-based stop loss being hit, with no active take-profit mechanism included. Position sizing is not handled as the EA has no order-opening logic. Money management is also absent since the trailing stop distance is entirely determined by the SAR parameters, without any additional risk percentage or fixed-pip stop loss configuration. Overall, this is a purely trend-following stop management tool that performs well in trending markets but may suffer from repeated stop-outs in choppy or range-bound conditions due to the frequent SAR flips.

parameters.name: SAR_Step
parameters.description: 抛物线SAR的加速因子步长，控制SAR逼近价格的速率
parameters.description_en: Parabolic SAR acceleration step, controls rate of SAR approaching price

parameters.name: SAR_Maximum
parameters.description: 抛物线SAR的加速因子上限，限制SAR跟踪的最大灵敏度
parameters.description_en: Parabolic SAR acceleration limit, caps maximum tracking sensitivity

parameters.name: ApplyToAllSymbols
parameters.description: 是否对所有交易品种的持仓应用追踪止损
parameters.description_en: Apply trailing stop to positions of all symbols

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: 指定只管理特定魔术号的持仓，0表示管理所有持仓
parameters.description_en: Manage positions with specific magic number only; 0 manages all

pros: 基于抛物线SAR的追踪止损逻辑简洁有效，能较好地跟随趋势锁定利润
作为纯工具类EA，不自行开仓，风险可控，不影响交易者的入场策略
参数简单直观，用户只需调整SAR步长和上限即可适配不同市场波动性
pros_en: The Parabolic SAR-based trailing stop logic is clean and effective, doing a good job of following trends to lock in profits
As a pure utility EA that does not open positions on its own, risk is controllable and it does not interfere with the trader's entry strategy
Parameters are simple and intuitive; users only need to adjust SAR step and maximum to adapt to different market volatility
cons: 在震荡行情中SAR频繁翻转，可能导致止损被反复触发造成多次小亏损
缺少主动止盈机制，无法在目标价位平仓，完全依赖被动止损出场
没有仓位检查和新Bar检查机制，可能在同一根K线上重复修改止损增加交易成本
cons_en: In choppy markets, SAR flips frequently which can cause the stop loss to be repeatedly triggered resulting in multiple small losses
Lacks an active take-profit mechanism and cannot close positions at target price levels, relying entirely on passive stop loss exits
No new bar check mechanism may cause repeated stop loss modifications on the same bar, increasing transaction costs from excessive modification requests
improvements: 增加新Bar检查机制，仅在新的K线形成时才修改止损，避免同Bar内重复操作
增加可选的固定点数或百分比止盈功能，配合SAR追踪止损实现更灵活的出场策略
improvements_en: Add a new bar check mechanism to only modify stops when a new bar forms, avoiding redundant operations within the same bar
Add an optional fixed-pip or percentage take-profit feature to complement the SAR trailing stop for a more flexible exit strategy

risk_points: 震荡市中SAR频繁翻转可能导致止损反复被触发，产生滑点和点差成本累积
缺少新Bar检查可能在Tick级别频繁修改订单，增加服务器负担和被拒绝的风险
risk_points_en: Frequent SAR flips in choppy markets can lead to repeated stop-outs and accumulated slippage and spread costs
Lack of new bar check may cause tick-level frequent order modifications, increasing server load and rejection risk
